name: OpenResto WhatsApp Confirmation State Machine v1

parameters.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const payload=JSON.parse(process.env.SESSION_PAYLOAD); const dir='/data/channel-state/sessions'; fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true}); const key=(payload.sender || 'unknown').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g,'_'); const out=path.join(dir, key + '.json'); fs.writeFileSync(out, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)); console.log(JSON.stringify({ persisted: true, path: out }));"

parameter.name: SESSION_PAYLOAD
parameter.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ sender: $json.verifiedSender.normalized, correlationId: $json.conversation.correlationId, intent: $json.llmResult.intent, confirmation: $json.confirmation, templateContext: $json.templateContext, updatedAtUtc: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

meta.purpose: Explicit confirmation gate and durable session state
